title: DeepSeek in China: AI Hiring or Bias Hiring?

live_model.evidence: "DeepSeek...has attracted global attention for its strong performance compared with models like OpenAI's GPT-4 Turbo and Google's Gemini 1.5 Pro."

prompt.location: Sec 3.2.1 (full Mandarin system-instruction prompt quoted, refined via pilot testing N=50)
prompt.note: This prompt was used with DeepSeek-reasoner, not GPT-4 Turbo.

claim.metric: none for GPT-4 Turbo; the paper's own CV-screening experiment (4,080 CV-job pairs, OLS regression on gender/age bias) runs deepseek-reasoner (April 2025) exclusively
claim.location: Sec 3.2.2 ("The deepseek-reasoner model was used as the primary scoring engine")

data.source: 255 scraped job listings and 4,080 synthetic CV-job pairs from BOSS Zhipin; no release statement found

notes: GPT-4 Turbo appears only once, as a comparison point in background text about DeepSeek's reputation. The entire experiment (CV-scoring bias audit) is run on DeepSeek's own API (deepseek-reasoner), which is outside OpenAI's tracked live-model list.
